why: From A to B three things change: the triangle turns a quarter turn anticlockwise, the arrow with the bar moves to the top-left and tilts (the bar becomes an X), and the three lines move to the bottom-right and flip upside down (longest line now at the bottom); the small dot moves one step clockwise around the cross. For C: the down triangle now points right, the arrow points down-right, the longest line is at the bottom and the dot sits above the X. Option 4 has all of this. Option 1 is the same except the dot is on the left of the X.
trick: With many small parts, check one part at a time and cross out options that fail any single part.
note: The tiny dot near the cross decides between option 1 and option 4; the scan shows the dot above the X in option 4 (book answer).
